data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 contradicts the regression suite skeleton defined by SRC_001, SRC_002, SRC_004, and SRC_005 because it introduces a rubric: eval form for the school-to-seat binding, which is incompatible with the program: eval-only constraint implied by the frozen-lease mechanism. The contradiction manifests when the suite tries to enforce both a homogeneous identity comparison (rubric) and a typed lease-mismatch assertion (program) on the same minimal fixture, since the two eval forms require mutually exclusive assertion structures. It is refuted if the regression suite skeleton can simultaneously carry a rubric: eval form and a program: eval form without the rubric undermining the program's machine-checkable typed-code assertion.
